config.label: Root of the CalDAV server, e
config.description: Root of the CalDAV server, e.g. https://dav.example.net. A calendar collection URL also works.

config.label: Account name
config.description: Account name. Most hosted services want an app-specific password with it.

config.label: Password or app-specific password
config.description: Password or app-specific password. Deleted from the environment once read.

config.label: Bearer token, as an alternative to username and password
config.description: Bearer token, as an alternative to username and password. Not both.

config.label: Comma-separated calendars this server may touch, by path or final path segment
config.description: Comma-separated calendars this server may touch, by path or final path segment. Default: all of them.

config.label: IANA zone for timestamps that carry no offset, e
config.description: IANA zone for timestamps that carry no offset, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default: UTC)

config.label: The address you are invited as, so respond_to_event can find your own attendee line
config.description: The address you are invited as, so respond_to_event can find your own attendee line

config.label: Entries a listing returns by default, 1 to 500 (default: 100)
config.description: Entries a listing returns by default, 1 to 500 (default: 100)

config.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)

config.label: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate on the configured host only (default: false)
config.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate on the configured host only (default: false)

config.description: Set to true to allow a plain http:// URL to a host that is not loopback, which sends the credentials unencrypted (default: false)

config.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
